title: Frank Zappa on Crossfire
summary: A clip of Frank Zappa appearing on CNN's Crossfire in 1986, debating censorship and copyright. Zappa argues his position against record labeling and content restrictions.
why: HN commenters invoke it in free speech and censorship debates as a classic example of a articulate defense of free expression.
